comment: Machine-readable version/encoding registry (HX-11, H9 seed). Normative prose: doc/KERNEL.md §1-§2. Both conformance runners load this file; a runner whose constants disagree with it fails.

operation_format_version.binding: persistent; signed and hashed into every operation preimage; a change is a new format generation
operation_format_version.status: draft-1, unfrozen until an explicit Decision Log freeze names a versioned profile

schema_epoch.binding: per-datastore causally ordered sequence, not a global constant; signed into every data operation; IR carries its own schema_ir_format_version (currently 1)
schema_epoch.status: draft-1 (M0b exit 2026-07-18); unfrozen until an explicit Decision Log freeze

snapshot_format_version.status: draft-1 (M0f); unfrozen until an explicit Decision Log freeze

storage_format_version.binding: local on-disk layout only; MUST NOT appear on the wire or in any preimage
storage_format_version.status: experimental v1 written by LocalStore; unfrozen (no Decision Log freeze)

relay_protocol_version.binding: connection negotiation only (HELLO/WELCOME); MUST NOT enter any operation preimage or persistent artifact

KeyId.derivation: BLAKE3(group symmetric key), truncated to 16 bytes

HLCTimestamp.encoding: physical_ms u64 + logical u16 + PeerId 32B; field names per doc/KERNEL.md §5

merkle.status: draft-1 (M0c exit 2026-07-18); unfrozen until an explicit Decision Log freeze

limits.status: provisional (ISSUES O6; ratified with the O6 fixture set)

blob_codecs.comment: BlobRef codec registry (DQ-6). v0.1 implementations parse BlobRef and reject with BLOB_UNSUPPORTED.
